audit.title: Claude Optimizer -- Config Audit
audit.caution1: Heuristic, not a verdict. Open each file and read it before changing anything:
audit.caution2: a wrong call here silently switches off instructions while the byte count improves.
audit.budget.heading: CONTEXT BUDGET (what loads on every single turn)
audit.budget.always: Always loaded:          {bytes} bytes (CLAUDE.md: {claudeMd}, rules: {rules} in {rulesCount} file(s){imported})
audit.budget.cardsWithImports: Context cards: {count} ({bytes} bytes, the cards CLAUDE.md does NOT import, so genuinely on demand; the imported ones are counted in "Always loaded" above)
audit.budget.cards: Context cards: {count} ({bytes} bytes, loaded conditionally by trigger, not part of the always-loaded budget)
audit.budget.broken: Broken @import lines: {count} (they load nothing at all, see the section below)
audit.inventory.heading: ALWAYS-LOADED DOCUMENTS, LARGEST FIRST
audit.inventory.intro: {count} document(s), {bytes} bytes in total. Any diet starts at the top of this list:
audit.inventory.empty: Nothing is always loaded at this path.
audit.arch.heading: THREE-LAYER ARCHITECTURE
audit.arch.v.noClaudeMd: no CLAUDE.md found at this path
audit.arch.v.importFull: full three-layer architecture in place, import-based (CLAUDE.md -> @import files -> on-demand docs)
audit.arch.v.importTwo: CLAUDE.md + @import files present, nothing left on demand (two-layer, import-based)
audit.arch.v.noRefsNoCond: CLAUDE.md + rules/ present, no references/ and no conditional rules (two-layer, references missing)
audit.arch.v.noRefs: CLAUDE.md + rules/ (with conditional rules) present, no references/ directory
audit.arch.v.full: full three-layer architecture in place (CLAUDE.md -> rules/ -> references/)
audit.broken.heading: BROKEN @import LINES (they load nothing, silently)
audit.broken.intro: {count} @import line(s) that inline no bytes at all:
audit.broken.line: {target} (cited in {citedIn}) -> {why}: this file is silently NOT loaded
audit.broken.nonText: exists at {path}, but its extension is not inlineable, so the import is skipped
audit.dead.heading: POINTERS TO FILES THAT DO NOT EXIST
audit.dead.none: None found. Every rules/, references/, hooks/, skills/, context/, commands/ and agents/ path cited in an always-loaded doc resolves to a real file.
audit.dup.heading: TEXT REPEATED ACROSS ALWAYS-LOADED DOCUMENTS (heuristic)
audit.dup.none: None found above the similarity threshold.
audit.dup.intro: {count} near-identical sentence pair(s) between CLAUDE.md and another always-loaded doc (rule or @import):
audit.dup.head: {file} (similarity {score})
audit.contra.heading: RULES THAT MAY CONTRADICT EACH OTHER (heuristic, needs human review)
audit.contra.none: None found. (This checks a fixed list of never/always + action-verb pairs, it is not exhaustive.)
audit.contra.intro: {count} candidate(s) where "never" and "always" apply to the same action across two always-loaded docs:
audit.contra.head: [{stem}] word overlap {overlap}
audit.cond.heading: RULES THAT COULD BECOME CONDITIONAL (heuristic, needs human review)
audit.cond.none: None found. No always-loaded rule looks dedicated to a single file type.
audit.cond.intro: {count} rule(s) that LOOK dedicated to one file type and are candidates for a paths: frontmatter block:
audit.cond.line: {file}: looks like {category} content ({hits} keyword hits, examples and negations already discounted)
audit.cond.action: -> CANDIDATE: if reading it confirms the topic, the paths: block would be {paths}
audit.demote.heading: IMPORTED FILES THAT COULD LEAVE THE ALWAYS-LOADED BUDGET (heuristic, needs human review)
audit.demote.none: None found. No imported file looks dedicated to a single topic.
audit.demote.intro: {count} imported file(s) that LOOK dedicated to a single topic. paths: does NOT work on an imported file:
audit.demote.remedy: the only way to take one out of the budget is to delete its @import line and cite the file as an on-demand reference (it stays on disk, it just stops being read on every session).
audit.demote.line: {file}: looks like {category} content ({hits} keyword hits, {bytes} bytes), imported by {importedBy}
audit.demote.action: -> CANDIDATE: open this file and judge what it is really about before removing anything.
audit.ignored.heading: paths: DECLARED IN A FILE THAT ARRIVES BY @import (the paths: is ignored)
audit.ignored.intro: {count} file(s) declare a paths: block and are pulled in by @import, so the gate never runs:
audit.ignored.line: {file} (imported by {importedBy}, {bytes} bytes): the paths: is IGNORED, this file loads in full on every session
audit.ignored.remedy1: Almost always an accident: someone meant a cheap conditional rule and got fixed weight instead.
audit.ignored.remedy2: For the paths: to gate anything, move the file into rules/ and delete the @import line.

migrate.checklist.budgetTokens: - budget_tokens is rejected with 400. Use thinking: {type: "adaptive"}.
migrate.checklist.sampling: - temperature / top_p / top_k are rejected with 400. Remove them.
migrate.checklist.prefill: - assistant-turn prefill (last message with role "assistant") is rejected with 400.
migrate.checklist.thinking: - thinking runs on by default and shares max_tokens with the visible response; a low max_tokens can now truncate mid-answer.
